item.title: In Lebanon, war and displacement mar run-up to Eid al-Fitr holiday for many
item.summary: In Lebanon, renewed hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah and displacement are draining the joy from Ramadan and the run-up to the Islamic holiday of Eid al-Fitr for many

item.title: Iran war expected to prevent Bank of England from cutting interest rates
item.summary: The Bank of England is holding its main interest rate at 3.75% in the wake of the oil and gas price hikes following the start of the Iran war

item.title: The war in Iran raises pressure on Ukraine while Russia prepares new offensives
item.summary: With U.S.-brokered Ukraine peace talks on hold due to the war in the Middle East, Russian President Vladimir Putin is expected to try to expand his military gains via new offensives against his southern neighbor that will put even more pressure on Kyiv

item.title: Pakistani Taliban announces 3-day ceasefire ahead of Eid truce
item.summary: A key outlawed Pakistani militant group behind numerous gun and bomb attacks has announced a three-day ceasefire ahead of Eid al-Fitr, hours after Pakistan and Afghanistan also declared a temporary halt to escalating fighting

item.summary: Bank of England holds main interest rate at 3.75% as Iran war jolts inflation expectations

item.title: North Korean leader Kim and his daughter ride a tank together during army training
item.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and his teenage daughter have ridden a tank together, days after they watched rocket launches and fired pistols

item.title: Under siege by a Mexican cartel, these civilians fight back with AK-47s and grenades
item.summary: Residents in the Mexican central state of Guerrero are setting up self-defense patrols to keep a powerful cartel out of their mountain towns

item.title: Madagascar's president orders lie detector tests for candidates applying to be government ministers
item.summary: Madagascar's military leader says anyone applying to become a minister in his new government will be subjected to lie detector tests to root out those who are corrupt

item.title: Rio police pull 4 officers from street duty in a probe into a deadly raid
item.summary: Authorities say that four Brazilian police officers have been removed from street duty in an investigation into their involvement in a deadly raid in a low-income part of Rio de Janeiro

item.title: A baseball title unleashes the happiness Venezuelans kept bottled up for years
item.summary: Venezuelans pour into the streets in a rare, loud release of joy after their team wins the World Baseball Classic
